refused_program.intent: Merge the upstream branch into the current fork, resolving dependency-file collisions by keeping local dependency choices and additions while retaining local removals and incorporating upstream additions.

postconditions.description: The upstream tip is now reachable from HEAD.
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: HEAD has a second parent, confirming that a merge commit was created.
postconditions.name: is_merge_commit

postconditions.description: The index has no remaining unmerged conflict entries.
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: The tracked working tree and index are clean after the merge commit.
postconditions.name: clean_after_commit

git diff --quiet &&
git diff --cached --quiet &&
test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n')"

postconditions.description: The merged tree still differs from upstream, so local dependency choices survived.
postconditions.name: retained_local_choices

postconditions.description: Tracked files contain no committed conflict-marker header.
postconditions.name: no_committed_conflict_markers

preconditions.description: HEAD is attached to a local branch rather than detached.
preconditions.name: on_local_branch

preconditions.description: There are no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes before merging.
preconditions.name: clean_worktree

preconditions.description: The current branch and the upstream-tracking branch have both advanced, so a merge is required.
preconditions.name: diverged_from_upstream
preconditions.probe:
git rev-parse --verify "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" >/dev/null &&
test "$(git rev-list --count "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}..HEAD")" -gt 0 &&
test "$(git rev-list --count "HEAD..{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}")" -gt 0

preconditions.description: Local and upstream both changed at least one common path, so dependency changes can collide.
preconditions.name: shares_changed_paths
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}") || exit 1
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
